whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: In this case, it's a concrete table and it weighs approximately 6,000 pounds. So obviously I couldn't make it outside and then move it in. So I had to form up and have the concrete pumped in from the street. And the entire slab is floating on inner tubes as an air suspension system. I gradually became bored with just recording tangible, recognizable objects. I tried to find ways that I could maybe start with a recognizable object, but alter that wavefront that's moving towards a holographic plate. I tried to set up an environment where there was a certain amount of randomness to how the wavefront would be altered. Transparent medium.
